title: BJP stuck by tweeting on Kisan Andolan | Opposition said BJP's mentality Kisan opposed to Kisan | Dblive
description: Last year, in the monsoon session of Parliament, the Modi government had passed three laws related to farming. The President also approved these laws. The laws that were approved include the first farmer produce trade and commerce (promotion and simplification) Bill, 2020, second agriculture (empowerment and protection) Price Husbandry and Agricultural Services Agreement Bill and Third Essential Commodities Amendment Bill, 2020. But as soon as these laws were passed, a ruckus started in the country. Farmers have surrounded Delhi for more than eight months. Meanwhile, farmer leader Rakesh Tikait also announced to surround Lucknow. On Tikait's statement, he tweeted a cartoon on BJP's Twitter account today. Which is being called anti -farmer.
